user.title: GI Flex
user.description: Interpret unfamiliar light commands with DeepSeek. Known Home Assistant commands can still run locally.

init.title: GI Flex speech
init.description: When enabled, unclear speech is sent once to OpenAI for transcription. This includes clarification replies and speech after a false wake, up to 20 seconds per turn. Exact familiar light commands stay local. The speech component keeps no audio recordings; Home Assistant conversation history still applies. Disable this option or select original GI to stop cloud audio. Leave the key blank to retain the saved key.

data.cloud_speech_enabled: Allow OpenAI transcription of unclear speech

error.openai_unavailable: Cannot access OpenAI GPT Transcribe with this key
